title: Marble from crash site tests about 40% iridium by XRF
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Marble from crash site tests about 40% iridium by XRF, about present day at New Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they got a very anomalous result. In fact, they got back an extremely high percentage of aridium, close to 40%.

related.note: This is the same marble and the same question of what it is made of as telling 4, but Zodakis's lab retest finds no iridium, so the two claims contradict each other.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a small marble found at the Aztec crash site in New Mexico, a place where a UFO is said to have come down, was tested with XRF, a machine that reads which elements a material contains using X-rays. He says the result was very unusual: close to 40 percent iridium, a rare metal. He links the find to Scott and Suzanne Ramsay, who are named as witnesses, and presents it as possible physical proof of the crash.
